notes.title: Stage IV: Update Available
notes.content:
🫡  Hello, Spacemen!

The [b]Verse Project[/b] team is excited to introduce a new update for our technical demo.
Yes, this is finally [b]Stage IV[/b]! However, this time, we have significantly deviated from our initial plans to focus more on important aspects.

We have concentrated on performance, network code optimization, orbital flights, and combat systems.

We hope this will add more variety to the gameplay experience, even at this early stage of development, and pave the way for new features in the near future.

🚨 [b]Remember[/b]: the technical demo is not a full-fledged game with complete gameplay, graphics, and visual effects.
It is merely a demonstration of our capabilities and may contain various issues and bugs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45280868/ec81bd8b7551a23a14ecb522b57cdce68ee096ac.jpg[/img]

[h1]📋 What's New?[/h1]

[h2]🪐 Orbital Flight[/h2]

We've lifted the restriction on flying only near the station—now you can embark on a journey around the [b]Moon[/b].

However, you cannot fly closer than [b]80 km[/b] to the surface or farther than [b]100,000 km[/b]. Landing has been postponed for future updates to allow us to refine this feature.

You now have access to a fully free orbital flight mode, where you can move with or without the flight assistant enabled.

For this update, we have significantly increased the power of ship engines to make space travel a bit easier.

This is a temporary measure, as we need to thoroughly test the world compositor under orbital speed conditions and make the gameplay more accessible until we implement all the necessary navigation tools.

[h2]🛰️ Orbital Objects[/h2]

The starting station, where your journey begins, now moves in orbit around the Moon.
Yes, in previous versions, it was stationary.

Additionally, we have added several orbital objects that you can find and visit.

Two of them are easily located in the ship's navigation panel (on the left); they can be selected as targets, so you will always know their positions.

[b]The others remain hidden[/b]—they have no navigation markers, but they can still be discovered and visited.

[h2]🔫 Close-Range Combat[/h2]

You can now [b]activate ship weapons and fire[/b] at close-range targets.

Each of the three available ships has its [b]own course weapons[/b] with unique characteristics.

You can test each one in battle against other players.

To add some variety, we've introduced the [b]Outlaw Roster[/b], where you can see the list of the most successful players.

For now, the list updates only after a [b]server restart[/b] (usually once a day).

[h2]🌚  Celestial Body Generation[/h2]

The [b]procedural generation[/b] of massive orbital objects has been significantly improved.

You will notice this when looking at the Moon—[b]performance has been enhanced[/b], and [b]landscape variety has increased[/b].

Although landing [b]is not yet possible[/b], some surface details can already be seen from low orbit.

This is far from a complete list of everything we've worked on.
You can experience all the new features firsthand in the [b]demo build[/b] [url=https://verseproject.online/]available on our website[/url].

Don't forget to share your thoughts in our [url=https://discord.gg/SdCPPkqRgM]Discord server[/url]—the Verse Project team will be happy to hear your feedback!

If you encounter any issues or bugs, please report them in the ⁠🆘〢support  channel in our discord or in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3135380/discussions/0/4630357016599089236]Steam community[/url].

[b]Thank you for your support![/b] 🚀

notes.title: Stage III Update Available
notes.content:
🫡 Hello, Spaceman! o7

We’re a bit late this time, as we needed to spend extra time on polishing, optimizations, and additional adjustments. The main goal of this update is to create truly large orbital structures that you can freely move around. This approach was chosen from the beginning to lay the groundwork for a variety of objects in space and on planetary surfaces.

[h3]The project demo is available on the [url=https://verseproject.online/]project website[/url]. This will be available on Steam at a later date.[/h3]

🚨 [b]The tech demo is not a game with full gameplay, graphics and visual effects. It is only a demonstration of our features.[/b]

Here’s a brief list of what’s included in this update:

[h3]Station Exterior[/h3]

Our first space station, HOST, which you’ve already seen from the inside, has received significant upgrades and added exterior details. This is not the final implementation, and we’ll continue to improve model and texture detail as our development tools advance.

[h3]Ship Flights[/h3]

In this update, you can now fly beyond the station on ships and return by requesting docking permission from the left navigation panel. The current flight model has limited functionality, and the free movement zone is limited to 10 km around the station. By default, each ship has a flight assist mode that helps control the ship and limits its speed. If desired, the assist can be turned off with the [b]B key[/b].

[h3]Sound Environment[/h3]

Our team has made substantial improvements to the project’s sound design. Many objects now have new sounds that were previously missing. Ships, engines, and various station structures are now partially voiced. We’re continuing to experiment in this area to further enhance the soundscape.

[h3]Visual Effects[/h3]

The effects for ships’ main and maneuvering thrusters have been reworked to better match the original concept. Particle effects around the moving ship have also been added.

[h3]Known Issues[/h3]

[list]
[*]In some cases, the elevator may move into open space when entered.
[*]Elevator shaft doors may fail to close.
[*]Significant FPS drops can occur inside a moving ship if you’re not seated in the pilot’s chair.
[*]Position synchronization over distances of several kilometers from the station may have inaccuracies.
[*]Object collisions may be inaccurate, potentially allowing the ship to partially pass through them.
[/list]

🚨 [b]Multiplayer bandwidth is also limited and will change as testing progresses.[/b]

For reporting bugs and issues, you can use the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3135380/discussions/0/4630357016599089236/]related thread[/url] in the discussions or project [url=https://discord.gg/SdCPPkqRgM]discord server[/url].
